dice.amethyst.desc: A mystic gem: pays {pay}$ per pip.
dice.amethyst.name: Amethyst Dice
dice.architect.desc: Builds: every {every} rolls it constructs a free dice of a type you own. Pays {pay}$ per pip.
dice.architect.name: Architect Dice
dice.ascension.desc: Grows forever: every roll permanently adds +1% to this dice (up to x10). Base {pay}$ per pip.
dice.ascension.name: Ascension Dice
dice.aura.desc: +1000 aura: dice within {radius}px earn +{bonus}%. Pays {pay}$ per pip.
dice.aura.name: Aura Dice
dice.bank.desc: Pays interest: 0.2% of your current money per roll (at least {pay}$, at most 50x).
dice.bank.name: Bank Dice
dice.bee.desc: Collects honey with every roll; a full jar (20) pays x30. Also pollinates a neighbour. Base {pay}$ per pip.
dice.bee.name: Bee Dice
dice.blackhole.desc: Gravity pulls dice within {radius}px toward it – they all roll. +1% per dice pulled. Base {pay}$ per pip.
dice.blackhole.name: Black Hole Dice
dice.bomb.desc: Counts down 3-2-1. On zero: BOOM – all dice within {radius}px roll and it pays x10. Base {pay}$.
dice.bomb.name: Bomb Dice
dice.bonk.desc: Bonks the {count} nearest dice (they roll). +10% per bonk. Base {pay}$ per pip.
dice.bonk.name: Bonk Dice
dice.bubble.desc: Pays {pay}$ per pip and pops when it lands, rolling up to {count} neighbours.
dice.bubble.name: Bubble Dice
dice.bunny.desc: Pays {pay}$ per pip. Bunnies multiply: every {every} bunny rolls a new bunny is born (max {max}).
dice.bunny.name: Bunny Dice
dice.burger.desc: Stacks up: every roll without a 1 adds +10% (up to +300%). Base {pay}$ per pip.
dice.burger.name: Burger Dice
dice.candy.desc: Pays {pay}$ per pip. Sugar rush: dice within {radius}px earn +{bonus}%.
dice.candy.name: Candy Dice
dice.car.desc: Drives in a straight line until it hits the wall. Every dice in its way rolls. Hitting the wall pays {pay}$ (+2% per dice hit) and sometimes a gold coin.
dice.car.name: Racing Car Dice
dice.clover.desc: Five faces pay {pay}x3$. The four-leaf clover pays seven times as much.
dice.clover.name: Clover Dice
dice.comet.desc: Streaks across the table – every dice along its tail rolls. Pays {pay}$ +3% per dice hit.
dice.comet.name: Comet Dice
dice.console.desc: Pays {pay}$ per pip. Rolled again within 4 seconds the combo rises (up to x{maxmult}).
dice.console.name: Console Dice
dice.cookie.desc: Pays {pay}$ per pip. Rolls you trigger yourself (click or hover) pay x{mult}.
dice.cookie.name: Cookie Dice
dice.cosmic.desc: Pays {pay}$ per pip, multiplied by (1 + active events), doubled during Golden Luck.
dice.cosmic.name: Cosmic Dice
dice.crown.desc: Royal decree: every Crown dice adds +1% to ALL income (up to +50%). Pays {pay}$ per pip.
dice.crown.name: Crown Dice
dice.cyber.desc: Pays {pay}$ per pip. 10% chance to glitch: x8!
dice.cyber.name: Cyber Dice
dice.divine.desc: Blesses everything: each Divine dice adds +5% to ALL income (up to +100%) and rolls itself every {interval} s. Pays {pay}$ per pip.
dice.divine.name: Divine Dice
dice.dnd.desc: A real D20: pays {pay}$ per pip. Natural 20 is a critical hit (x20), natural 1 a critical fail (0$).
dice.dnd.name: D20 Dungeon Dice
dice.doge.desc: Much random, very wow: pays between x0.1 and x10 of {pay}$. 1% TO THE MOON pays x100.
dice.doge.name: Doge Dice
dice.domino.desc: Topples the next Domino dice, which topples the next… Each step of the chain pays +5% more. Base {pay}$ per pip.
dice.domino.name: Domino Dice
dice.donut.desc: Pays {pay}$ per pip. Face 1 collects a sprinkle; with 6 sprinkles the next donut roll pays x36.
dice.donut.name: Donut Dice
dice.dragon.desc: Pays {pay}$ per pip and breathes fire in a {radius}px cone – everything in it rolls (max {count}).
dice.dragon.name: Dragon Dice
dice.elderdragon.desc: Ancient fire: a {radius}px cone of flames rolls up to {count} dice that pay x3. Base {pay}$ per pip.
dice.elderdragon.name: Elder Dragon Dice
dice.emerald.desc: A royal gem: pays {pay}$ per pip.
dice.emerald.name: Emerald Dice
dice.fire.desc: Pays {pay}$ per pip and sets the table on fire: dice within {radius}px roll too (max {count}).
dice.fire.name: Fire Dice
dice.fox.desc: Clever: adds the highest recent payout of a dice within {radius}px to its own {pay}$ per pip.
dice.fox.name: Fox Dice
dice.galaxy.desc: Pays {pay}$ per pip, +1% for every 10 dice you own.
dice.galaxy.name: Galaxy Dice
dice.ghost.desc: Pays {pay}$ per pip, then haunts a random spot of the table and scares 2 dice into rolling.
dice.ghost.name: Ghost Dice
dice.gigachad.desc: Always rolls a 6. No luck needed. Pays {pay}$ per pip.
dice.gigachad.name: Gigachad Dice
dice.godot.desc: Node tree: pays {pay}$ per pip for every dice type you own. A 6 emits a signal that rolls all other Godot dice.
dice.godot.name: Godot Dice
dice.golem.desc: A slow giant: rolls take 3x longer but pay {pay}$ per pip.
dice.golem.name: Golem Dice
dice.ice.desc: Pays {pay}$ per pip and freezes dice within {radius}px: their next payout is doubled.
dice.ice.name: Ice Dice
dice.infinity.desc: Pays {pay}$ per pip, +5% per achievement and +4% per dice type owned.
dice.infinity.name: Infinity Dice
dice.jackpot.desc: Every roll feeds the progressive jackpot; 1% chance to win the whole pot! Base {pay}$ per pip.
dice.jackpot.name: Jackpot Dice
dice.knight.desc: Pays {pay}$ per pip. Its shield protects dice within {radius}px: +{bonus}% payout.
dice.knight.name: Knight Dice
dice.kraken.desc: Eight tentacles roll {count} random dice anywhere on the table. Pays {pay}$ per pip.
dice.kraken.name: Kraken Dice
dice.lava.desc: Every 10th roll erupts: all dice within {radius}px roll and pay double. Base {pay}$ per pip.
dice.lava.name: Lava Dice
dice.lightning.desc: Pays {pay}$ per pip and strikes {count} random dice anywhere on the table.
dice.lightning.name: Lightning Dice
dice.luckyblock.desc: Every landing opens the block: coins, jackpots, Lucky Cube levels, a dice rain, sometimes even talent gold – or an explosion!
dice.luckyblock.name: Lucky Block Dice
dice.magic8.desc: YES: dice within {radius}px get double payout on their next roll. NO: nothing. ASK AGAIN: rolls itself again. Base {pay}$.
dice.magic8.name: Magic 8-Ball Dice
dice.mahjong.desc: Draws tiles 1-9. Three equal tiles in a row (across all Mahjong dice) call MAHJONG: x13! Base {pay}$ per pip.
dice.mahjong.name: Mahjong Dice
dice.meteor.desc: Impacts the table: dice within {radius}px roll with +50%. Pays {pay}$ per pip.
dice.meteor.name: Meteorite Dice
dice.mithril.name: Mithril Dice
dice.moon.desc: Pays {pay}$ per pip – triple while any event is active.
dice.moon.name: Moon Dice
dice.nebula.desc: Cosmic aura: dice within {radius}px earn +{bonus}%. Pays {pay}$ per pip.
dice.nebula.name: Nebula Dice
dice.ninja.desc: Strikes in a flash (very fast roll) and throws shuriken at 2 distant dice. Pays {pay}$ per pip.
dice.ninja.name: Ninja Dice
dice.nyan.desc: Flies with a rainbow: every dice under its flight path rolls with +20%. Pays {pay}$ per pip.
dice.nyan.name: Nyan Dice
dice.obsidian.name: Obsidian Dice
dice.ohio.desc: Only in Ohio: anything can happen – x20, nothing at all, teleports, or the whole table rolls. Base {pay}$ per pip.
dice.ohio.name: Ohio Dice
dice.omega.desc: The final dice: five sixes and one 66. Pays {pay}$ per pip.
dice.omega.name: Omega Dice
dice.owl.desc: Wise: pays {pay}$ per pip, +2% for every unlocked achievement.
dice.owl.name: Owl Dice
dice.paper.desc: Light as paper: rolls 2.5x faster. Pays {pay}$ times the face.
dice.paper.name: Paper Dice
dice.pepe.desc: Four frog faces pay {pay}$. 'Feels good man' pays x10, the sad frog pays nothing. Sometimes it hops again on its own.
dice.pepe.name: Pepe Dice
dice.phoenix.desc: Rolling a 1 burns it to ashes (0$) – the next roll is a rebirth paying x10. Base {pay}$ per pip.
dice.phoenix.name: Phoenix Dice
dice.pirate.desc: Coins pay {pay}x3$, the skull pays nothing, the chest pays x10 and the parrot rolls a neighbour. Plunders 3% of nearby payouts.
dice.pirate.name: Pirate Dice
dice.pizza.desc: Pays {pay}$ per pip. Every 8th pizza roll is a pizza party: x8!
dice.pizza.name: Pizza Dice
dice.platinum.name: Platinum Dice
dice.pumpkin.desc: Grows while it rests: +5% every 10 s since its last roll (up to x10). Workers leave it alone. Base {pay}$ per pip.
dice.pumpkin.name: Pumpkin Dice
dice.quantum.desc: Superposition: rolls two faces at once and pays both. Double six is entangled: x36. Base {pay}$ per pip.
dice.quantum.name: Quantum Dice
dice.rainbow.desc: Counts as every type: +5% per dice type you own. Pays {pay}$ per pip.
dice.rainbow.name: Rainbow Dice
dice.rickroll.desc: Never gonna give you up: it never pays less than 3 pips. A 6 never lets you down: x6! Base {pay}$.
dice.rickroll.name: Rickroll Dice
dice.robot.desc: Rolls itself every {interval} s – no worker needed. Pays {pay}$ per pip.
dice.robot.name: Robot Dice
dice.rocket.desc: Launches into the sky and crashes down somewhere else: the shockwave rolls dice within {radius}px. Pays {pay}$.
dice.rocket.name: Rocket Dice
dice.roulette.desc: 37 pockets: green zero pays x36, red pays x2, black x1. Base {pay}$.
dice.roulette.name: Roulette Dice
dice.ruby.desc: A polished gem: pays {pay}$ per pip.
dice.ruby.name: Ruby Dice
dice.samurai.desc: Pays {pay}$ per pip. A 6 slices the table: every dice on its row rolls (max {count}).
dice.samurai.name: Samurai Dice
dice.sapphire.desc: A flawless gem: pays {pay}$ per pip.
dice.sapphire.name: Sapphire Dice
dice.sigma.desc: Grindset: +10% for every worker roll in a row (up to x6). Your own click resets the grind. Base {pay}$ per pip.
dice.sigma.name: Sigma Dice
dice.sixseven.desc: Faces 6 and 7 pay {pay}$ each pip. The 67 face pays 67 pips. A 6 followed by a 7 on the same dice pays x6.7!
dice.sixseven.name: 67 Dice
dice.skeleton.desc: Collects bones: every skull rolled by a 50/50 dice adds +0.1% (up to x4). Base {pay}$ per pip.
dice.skeleton.name: Skeleton Dice
dice.skibidi.desc: Spins on its own every {interval} s. Each auto-spin adds +1% brainrot (up to +100%); your click resets it. Base {pay}$ per pip.
dice.skibidi.name: Skibidi Dice
dice.slot.desc: Spins three reels: 7-7-7 pays x77, three of a kind x10, a pair x2. Base {pay}$.
dice.slot.name: Slot Machine Dice
dice.snail.desc: Very slow (rolls take 3x longer) but pays {pay}$ per pip.
dice.snail.name: Snail Dice
dice.stone.desc: Heavy and reliable: pays {pay}$ per pip.
dice.stone.name: Stone Dice
dice.stonks.desc: Pays {pay}$ per pip times the Stonks market (x0.5 to x20). The market updates every 45 s and mostly goes up.
dice.stonks.name: Stonks Dice
dice.sun.desc: Sunshine: every Sun dice adds +3% to ALL income (up to +150%). Pays {pay}$ per pip.
dice.sun.name: Sun Dice
dice.supernova.desc: Charges up for 10 rolls, then explodes: up to {count} dice all over the table roll and pay double. Base {pay}$ per pip.
dice.supernova.name: Supernova Dice
dice.sus.desc: Pays {pay}$ per pip. 10%: EMERGENCY MEETING – all dice within {radius}px roll. 5%: ejected, pays nothing.
dice.sus.name: Sus Dice
dice.sushi.desc: Pays {pay}$ per pip, +25% for every other food dice type you own.
dice.sushi.name: Sushi Dice
dice.tetris.desc: Each roll drops a block. 10 blocks clear a line (all block dice pay x10). Four lines in 30 s: TETRIS (x100)!
dice.tetris.name: Block Dice
dice.thisisfine.desc: Everything is on fire: ignites dice within {radius}px and earns +5% per dice currently rolling (up to x3). Base {pay}$ per pip.
dice.thisisfine.name: This Is Fine Dice
dice.timedie.desc: Rewind: 25% chance to land again and pay again (up to 3 times). Base {pay}$ per pip.
dice.timedie.name: Time Dice
dice.train.desc: Races along its row across the whole table, rolling every dice on the track (max {count}). Pays {pay}$ +2% per dice.
dice.train.name: Train Dice
dice.treasure.desc: Finds a key with 1/3 chance. With 3 keys the chest opens: x50! Otherwise pays {pay}$.
dice.treasure.name: Treasure Chest Dice
dice.troll.name: Troll Dice
dice.twitch.desc: Pays {pay}$ per pip plus 2$ per viewer. Every roll brings viewers; sometimes a RAID rolls 10 dice and pays x10.
dice.twitch.name: Stream Dice
dice.ufo.desc: Pays {pay}$ per pip and abducts a random dice: it lands somewhere else and pays x3.
dice.ufo.name: UFO Dice
dice.vampire.desc: Pays {pay}$ per pip and drains 10% of the last payouts of dice within {radius}px (they keep theirs).
dice.vampire.name: Vampire Dice
dice.vault.desc: Pays half of {pay}$ per pip and locks the other half in the vault. Every {every} rolls the vault opens and pays its content x{mult}.
dice.vault.name: Vault Dice
dice.viking.desc: Pays {pay}$ per pip. A 6 blows the war horn: all Viking dice roll (max {count}).
dice.viking.name: Viking Dice
dice.witch.desc: Pays {pay}$ per pip. 25%: brews a potion – dice within {radius}px pay x3 on their next roll.
dice.witch.name: Witch Dice
dice.wizard.desc: Pays {pay}$ per pip and enchants a random dice: its next roll pays x10.
dice.wizard.name: Wizard Dice
dice.wood.name: Wooden Dice
dice.youtube.desc: Pays {pay}$ per pip plus subscribers/10. Each roll gains subscribers; every milestone (100, 1K, 10K…) pays a play-button bonus.
dice.youtube.name: Video Dice
dice.zombie.desc: Pays {pay}$ per pip. Bites: {chance}% chance to turn a nearby 50/50 or D4 into another zombie (max {max}).
dice.zombie.name: Zombie Dice

staff.banker.name: BANKER
staff.chef.desc: Food and animal dice earn +10% per chef.
staff.chef.name: CHEF
staff.dj.desc: Plays a beat drop every 120 seconds (more DJs = more often, at most every 20 s): all income x2 for 6 seconds.
staff.dj.name: DJ
staff.dj_drop: BEAT DROP! ALL INCOME x2 FOR {s} S
staff.janitor.desc: Every 6 seconds re-rolls up to 3 dice that paid nothing (skulls, misses).
staff.janitor.name: JANITOR
staff.mage.desc: Every 30 seconds enchants a dice: its next roll pays x10.
staff.mage.name: MAGE
staff.mechanic.desc: Rolls one of your new dice every 5 seconds (more mechanics = more often).
staff.mechanic.name: MECHANIC
staff.merchant.desc: Per merchant: selling returns 3% more and new dice cost 1% less (max 15%).
staff.merchant.name: MERCHANT
staff.miner.desc: Every 20 seconds digs up money: 1 second of your income per miner.
staff.miner.name: MINER
staff.monk.desc: Sacrificed dice count 8% more for tarot cards per monk.
staff.monk.name: MONK
staff.scientist.desc: Every 10 minutes a random dice type you own gets +1 level.
staff.scientist.name: SCIENTIST
talent.bdr_aura_radius_desc: Area effects of the new dice reach 30% farther.
talent.bdr_auto_speed_desc: Self-rolling dice (robot, clock, ...) roll 43% more often.
talent.bdr_chain_power_desc: Dice that make other dice roll push 50% more of them.
talent.bdr_event_freq_2_desc: Random events happen another 25% more often.
talent.bdr_event_reward_desc: Rewards from random events are doubled.
talent.bdr_offering_bonus_desc: Sacrificed dice count 50% more towards tarot cards.
talent.bdr_sell_1_desc: Selling dice in the shop returns 10% more.
talent.bdr_sell_2_desc: Selling dice in the shop returns another 20% more.
talent.bdr_staff_limit_1_desc: You can hire 10 more of every new staff type.
talent.bdr_staff_limit_2_desc: You can hire 15 more of every new staff type.
talent.families_desc: Opens the family branches. Every family talent boosts all dice of that family.
talent.training_desc: Workers can also roll the new dice up to tier {n}.
talent.unlock_desc: Unlocks the {name} (tier {tier}) in the shop. Already unlocked? Then it gets +3 levels.
tarot.m_cups_1.desc: Per point of Power: lucky cubes cost 15% less and unlock new dice 50% more often.
tarot.m_cups_1.name: Ace of Cups
tarot.m_cups_10.desc: Every random event also starts a lucky streak (20 s per point of Power).
tarot.m_cups_10.name: Ten of Cups
tarot.m_cups_2.desc: Food dice earn +25% per point of Power.
tarot.m_cups_2.name: Two of Cups
tarot.m_cups_3.desc: Animal dice earn +25% per point of Power.
tarot.m_cups_3.name: Three of Cups
tarot.m_cups_4.desc: Luck dice earn +25% per point of Power.
tarot.m_cups_4.name: Four of Cups
tarot.m_cups_5.desc: Lucky cubes cost 5% less per point of Power.
